manufacture an excuse: Whenever he forgets his homework, Tom quickly manufactures an excuse, like his dog eating it.
每當忘了寫作業，湯姆就會很快編造藉口，像是作業被狗吃了。
manufacture evidence: The detective was sent to prison after it was proven that he had helped manufacture evidence against an innocent man.
那名警探被證實曾協助偽造證據陷害一名無辜男子後，被送進監獄。
manufacture cars: That factory in Germany can manufacture cars at a rate of one every two minutes.
德國那家工廠每兩分鐘就能製造出一輛汽車。
manufactured outrage: Many viewers felt the TV host's anger was just manufactured outrage meant to get more attention online.
許多觀眾覺得那位節目主持人的怒氣只是刻意製造的憤慨，為了在網路上博取更多關注。
map out a plan: Before starting the business, the two friends sat down to map out a plan for the first year.
在創業之前，這兩個朋友坐下來規劃了第一年的計畫。
map the human genome: It took scientists from many countries more than ten years to map the human genome.
來自許多國家的科學家花了十多年才繪製出人類基因圖譜。
map one's future: The school counselor helps seniors map their future by talking about their interests and possible careers.
學校輔導老師透過討論興趣和可能的職業，幫助高三生規劃未來。
put on the map: Winning the international film award put the small town on the map, and tourists started arriving.
贏得國際電影獎讓這座小鎮聲名大噪，遊客開始湧入。
march for peace: Thousands of students carried signs and sang songs as they marched for peace through the city.
數千名學生舉著標語、唱著歌，在城市中為和平遊行。
march on the capital: The rebel army planned to march on the capital and force the king to give up his throne.
叛軍計畫向首都進軍，迫使國王退位。
time marches on: We may wish our childhood would last forever, but time marches on and we all grow up.
我們或許希望童年永遠持續，但時間不斷前進，我們都會長大。
march into the office: Angry about the mistake, the customer marched into the office and demanded to see the manager.
因為那個錯誤而生氣，那位顧客大步走進辦公室，要求見經理。
mark the anniversary: The city held a big concert in the park to mark the anniversary of its founding.
市政府在公園舉辦一場大型音樂會，以紀念建市週年。
mark a turning point: The invention of the smartphone marked a turning point in the way people communicate with each other.
智慧型手機的發明標誌著人們彼此溝通方式的轉捩點。
mark homework: Our English teacher stays at school until seven every evening to mark homework for all her classes.
我們的英文老師每天晚上留在學校到七點，批改她所有班級的作業。
mark one's words: Mark my words: if you keep spending money like this, you will have nothing left by next month.
記住我的話：如果你繼續這樣花錢，到下個月你就什麼都不剩了。
mark down prices: At the end of the season, many shops mark down prices on summer clothes to make room for new items.
季末時，許多商店會把夏裝降價，好騰出空間放新商品。
mark time: Without any new orders, the factory could only mark time and wait for the economy to improve.
沒有任何新訂單，那家工廠只能原地踏步，等待經濟好轉。
marshal one's thoughts: Before answering the difficult interview question, she paused for a moment to marshal her thoughts.
在回答那道困難的面試問題前，她停頓了一下來整理思緒。
marshal evidence: The lawyer spent weeks trying to marshal evidence that would prove his client was not at the scene.
那位律師花了好幾週整理證據，以證明他的委託人不在現場。
marshal support: The mayor visited every neighborhood to marshal support for the plan to build a new library.
市長走訪每個社區，為興建新圖書館的計畫集結支持。
marshal resources: After the earthquake, the government had to marshal resources quickly to provide food and shelter for victims.
地震過後，政府必須迅速調度資源，為災民提供食物和住所。
mask one's feelings: Although she was very disappointed, she tried to mask her feelings and congratulated the winner with a smile.
雖然她非常失望，她仍試著掩飾感受，微笑著恭喜贏家。
mask the taste: My mom adds honey to the bitter medicine to mask the taste so my little brother will drink it.
我媽媽在苦藥裡加蜂蜜來蓋過味道，這樣我弟弟才肯喝。
mask the problem: Taking painkillers every day may mask the problem, but it will not cure what is causing your pain.
每天吃止痛藥也許能掩蓋問題，但無法治好造成疼痛的原因。
mask a smell: He lit a scented candle to mask a smell coming from the kitchen before his guests arrived.
客人到來前，他點了一根香氛蠟燭來遮蓋廚房傳來的氣味。
master a language: It usually takes many years of daily practice to master a language well enough to write novels in it.
通常需要多年每天練習，才能精通一種語言到可以用它寫小說的程度。
master one's fear: To become a firefighter, Jack had to master his fear of heights during months of hard training.
為了成為消防員，傑克在數月的艱苦訓練中必須克服懼高的恐懼。
master a skill: You cannot master a skill like playing the violin in a week; it takes patience and practice.
像拉小提琴這樣的技能不可能一週就掌握，那需要耐心和練習。
master the art of: My grandmother has mastered the art of making dumplings, and hers are the best in our town.
我奶奶精通包水餃之道，她包的是我們鎮上最好吃的。
